label: Claim verification — 5 bugfixes (normalizer, exports, cached confidence, registration, shutdown protocol)
summary: Fixed 5 issues in claim-verification: normalizeSource now preserves source-level markers while stripping quotes; VerifierBusyError exported from index.ts; cached results use proper aggregateConfidence logic (contradicts→min, entails→confidence, else→0); ModelRegistration extended with displayName/providerUri; WorkerProxy.shutdown awaits shutdownComplete message before falling back to exit event.

changes.kind: Added VerifierBusyError to re-export block (without local import, avoiding TS6133)
Cached result aggregateConfidence uses entailment-conditional logic instead of raw cached.confidence
ModelRegistration call in warmUp() now includes displayName and providerUri fields
shutdown() awaits shutdownComplete message before 2s timeout fallback (instead of raw exit listener)

handoff_notes: embedding-provider/src/fastembed.ts has a co-mingled diff from parallel agent work (ResolutionError + BGE-M3/CodeXEmbed models). The import of ResolutionError on line 4 is used on line 366 via `throw new ResolutionError(...)` — the build passes on fresh compile (--skip-nx-cache), so the earlier cache-hit failure was a stale-dist artifact.
VerifierBusyError is re-exported via `export { VerifierBusyError } from './errors.js'` in the export block — NOT via import+re-export, to avoid TS6133 unused-import error.
